quickActions.label: Deletion
quickActions.description: I don't want this in the message.

quickActions.label: 🗺️ Missing overview
quickActions.description: Provide a narrative overview of what is being built, why it is being built, and how it will be built. Add this before the implementation details.

quickActions.label: 🔍 Verify this
quickActions.description: This seems like an assumption. Verify by reading the actual code before proceeding.

quickActions.label: 🔬 Give me an example
quickActions.description: This is too abstract. Show a before/after, a sample input/output, or a specific scenario so I can see how this actually works.

quickActions.label: 🧬 Match existing patterns
quickActions.description: Search the codebase for existing patterns, components, or utilities that already solve this. Reuse what exists rather than introducing a new approach.

quickActions.label: 🔄 Consider alternatives
quickActions.description: Propose 2-3 alternative approaches with trade-offs based on the actual codebase. Also check the Plannotator plans directory (PLANNOTATOR_DATA_DIR or ~/.plannotator/plans/) for prior plan versions that may have already explored or rejected similar approaches.

quickActions.label: 📉 Ensure no regression
quickActions.description: Verify that this change will not break existing behavior. Identify what could regress and how to protect against it.

quickActions.label: 🚫 Out of scope
quickActions.description: This is not part of the current task. Remove it and stay focused on what was actually requested.
